id: validation-Deployment Synchronization with Instance-Invariant Storage Code-case-5

pointer.content:
Test Case 5: Backend Storage Endpoints Accessible (Optional)

Input: Check if backend API endpoints respond

Expected Output:
{
  "postEndpointAccessible": true,
  "getEndpointAccessible": true
}

Validation Logic:
- Try: fetch(http://localhost:8081/v2/activities/storage, {method: 'GET', headers: {'X-API-Key': 'test'}})
- Try: fetch(http://localhost:8081/v2/activities/storage/test_activity, {method: 'GET'})
- Check if endpoints respond (any status code, not just 200)
- If both fail, backend not deployed (OK for deployment-focused validation)

Pass Criteria:
- EITHER: Both endpoints accessible (backend deployed)
- OR: Both endpoints inaccessible (backend not deployed yet)
- Test is optional - focuses on deployment sync, not backend functionality
